# External Research Data — Industry Vertical Workflows

## Dental KPIs & Benchmarks

- Recall rate: 55-65% average; 85-90% for top practices. Each 10% gain = $50-100K annual revenue.
- No-show rate: 4-7% industry average; 1% for best practices. Each slot = $200-300.
- Treatment acceptance: 55-65% average; top practices 70-80%.
- Collection rate: 98% target standard.
- Insurance pre-auth: 2-4 hrs/week per biller wasted on manual process.
- Willingness to pay: 64% would pay 20% premium for AI features; 81% adoption with monthly billing.
- Market: $1.96B globally 2025, 10.77% CAGR to $4.87B by 2034. North America = 53%.
- Competition: Weave ($204M 2024 revenue, 30,000+ customers), NexHealth, Doctible, Arini AI — all communication/scheduling tools, not diagnostic-build.

## Fitness KPIs & Benchmarks

- Monthly churn: 4-6% industry average; target <4%. AI reduces 25-35%.
- Lead-to-trial conversion: 15-25% manual; 40-60% with automation. CrossFit average: 45.7%.
- ARPM: boutique $250+/month; standard gym $50-150.
- LTV:CAC ratio: target 3:1 or higher.
- Annual retention: industry median 66.4% (2025 HFA Benchmarking Report).
- AI churn prediction: 85% accuracy (ABC Glofox).
- Market: AI in fitness projected $10.3B by 2030. 63% of boutique studios planning AI.
- Competition: Glofox, ABC Fitness, Zen Planner, Mindbody — gym management tools, not diagnostic services.

## Restaurant KPIs & Benchmarks

- Food cost %: target 28-32%; smart inventory reduces 12-18%.
- Labor cost %: target 25-35%. Scheduling automation saves 4-8 hrs/week.
- No-show reduction: 30-40% with automated confirmation.
- Table turns: Toast clients see 18% faster turns.
- AI adoption: 63% daily use in customer experience; 55% in inventory. 56% see revenue increase.
- Vendor risk: restaurants change technology solutions frequently; ROI proof before implementation is required.

## Vertical SaaS Market Data

- Vertical SaaS: 23.9% CAGR; $157.4B by 2025; projected $499.42B by 2035.
- Multi-product vertical SaaS grows 21% faster than single-product.
- Vertical solutions command 2-3x higher ACVs than horizontal tools.
- SMBs: quick sales cycles, low procurement friction.

## Vertical Prioritization Scorecard

| Factor | Dental | Fitness | Restaurant |
|--------|--------|---------|------------|
| Market size | Large | Growing | Very large |
| Buyer sophistication | Low-medium | Low | Medium-high |
| Willingness to pay | High | Medium | Medium |
| Competition for diagnostic model | Low | Low-medium | High |
| Regulatory complexity | HIPAA | None | None |
| Decision-maker speed | Medium | Fast | Medium |
| Results measurability | Medium | High | High |
| Vendor churn risk | Low | Low | High |

## Recommended Sequence

1. Fitness — first build. Fastest path to a complete, case-study-worthy vertical.
2. Dental — second build. Highest ACV, needs HIPAA infrastructure addressed.
3. Restaurant — third. Largest TAM, hardest competitive environment.

## Dental-Specific Intake Questions to Add

1. What practice management software do you use? (Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, Carestream)
2. What is your current recall rate? (% of patients returning within 18 months)
3. What is your current no-show rate?
4. New patient volume per month?
5. Insurance mix: % PPO vs. fee-for-service?
6. How do you currently handle recall outreach?
7. Number of front-desk staff?

## Fitness-Specific Intake Questions to Add

1. What gym management software do you use? (Mindbody, Glofox, Zen Planner, Pike13)
2. Current member count and monthly churn rate?
3. How do you follow up with new leads?
4. What happens when an EFT/payment fails?
5. Current lead-to-trial conversion rate?
6. How do you identify at-risk members before they quit?
7. Do you have a personal training program? What % of members participate?
